rootCauseHypothesis:
The hosted app is rendering a stale or incorrect Sankey label format, likely due to a production-side formatting regression or an older cached build. The data and chart are present, but the label text generator is omitting the required middle-dot character, causing the DOM text to differ from the expected test string. Underlying error: TEST FAILURE

The Sankey node labels do not match the required text. The candidate names and totals are shown, but the middle-dot separator is missing.

Observations:
- The Sankey title reads “Transfers from round 1 into round 2.”
- The Sankey SVG has the required aria-label and six link paths.
- The rendered labels show “Golden, Jared F. 142,440” and “Poliquin, Bruce 138,931,” without “·.”

recommendedFixTarget.rationale: Update the Sankey node label formatting in the production build to include the middle-dot separator between the candidate name and the total (for example, render labels as `Golden, Jared F. · 142,440` and `Poliquin, Bruce · 138,931`). This likely means fixing the label formatter/template used by the chart data or SVG text rendering, then redeploying the app so the hosted version reflects the corrected string output.
